finish_summary: Frozen /app/circuit.spi: redesigned mirrored-bias, cascoded NMOS-input two-stage amplifier with cascoded NMOS output, PMOS current source, RC Miller compensation and decoupled bias nodes. Local original-bench measurements at TT/27 C: gain 79.216 dB, UGF 105.45 MHz, PM 64.32 degrees, GM 11.83 dB, DC supply power including reference 274.72 uW, zero devices below Vdsat. Estimated 1%-of-step settling relative to measured final levels: rising 12.11 ns, falling 6.87 ns. These are development measurements, not an independent scorer result. The A2 application requirements are NOT all met. Gain-4 CL=6 pF DC sweeps at all nine PVT combinations showed errors up to 18.906 mV (FF/85 C), despite VDD power staying below 286.46 uW. Sample gain-1 CL=6 pF sweeps also failed precision, reaching 22.78 mV error at FF/85 C. Sample overload tests failed absolute recovery accuracy (e.g. final remote outputs approximately 0.64791 V TT/27 C, 0.65410 V SS/-20 C and 0.63447 V FF/85 C instead of 0.65 V). Sample application total positive source power stayed below 320 uW, with measured maximum 303.27 uW among the reported gain-4 TT/27, SS/-20 and FF/85 cases; input DC currents were zero in these simulations. Full 54-case tracking signoff was not run; no FullPass is claimed. Public policy-check script at the documented path was unavailable. Final independent verification is still required.
